info.name: Finthos API
info.description:
End-to-end checks for the Finthos digital-wallet API (contract: docs/openapi.yaml).

Run everything with `npm test` in the `postman/` folder (see postman/README.md): it starts a mock
payment processor and the app, runs **00 Setup**, promotes the merchant/admin users, then runs the
remaining folders in order. Every run registers fresh users, so runs are independent.

exec: // One id per run so every run registers fresh users (keeps runs independent).

item.name: 00 Setup
item.description:
Registers the users the other folders need. Run this folder first.

The API cannot create ADMIN or MERCHANT users, so after this folder the runner
(`postman/run-api-tests.js`) promotes them directly in the database:

```sql
UPDATE users SET role = 'MERCHANT' WHERE id = '<merchantId>';
UPDATE users SET role = 'ADMIN'    WHERE id = '<adminId>';
```

When running by hand in Postman, execute those statements (ids are in the environment) before running the rest.
